paite: Ka Pathian, ka Pathian, bang achia non paisan? Bang achia hon panpih ding a na gamlat mahmah a, ka thumna thute a kipan a na gamlat?
heading: Lapu Lian A Ding. Phatna La / Lungkham A Kahna Leh Phatna La
english: For the Chief Musician; set to “The Doe of the Morning.” A Psalm by David. My God, my God, why have you forsaken me? Why are you so far from helping me, and from the words of my groaning?

paite: Ka Pathian aw, sun in ka kikou a, himahleh na dawng tuan kei a; zan in leng ka kikou a, ka dai tuan kei hi.
english: My God, I cry in the daytime, but you don’t answer; in the night season, and am not silent.

paite: Himahleh, nang Israelte phatna a tengpa aw, nang zaw na siangthou hi.
english: But you are holy, you who inhabit the praises of Israel.

paite: Ka pipute un nang hon na muang ua, amuang ua, huchi in nang na humbit zel hi.
english: Our fathers trusted in you. They trusted, and you delivered them.

paite: Nang ahon sam ua, huchi in humbit in a-om zel ua, ahon muang ua, huchi in zahlak in a-om ngei kei uhi.
english: They cried to you, and were delivered. They trusted in you, and were not disappointed.

paite: Kei zaw mihing ka hi kei a, tangtel phet ka hi a; mihingte gensiat leh mite muhsit ka hi.
english: But I am a worm, and no man; a reproach of men, and despised by the people.

paite: Ahon mu peuh in hon nuihsan ua, amuk uh alawksak ua, alu uh asing uh.
english: All those who see me mock me. They insult me with their lips. They shake their heads, saying,

paite: TOUPA muang hiven, ama'n amah humbitleh ake; atung a akipah ziak in humbitleh ake, achi uhi.
english: “He trusts in Yahweh. Let him deliver him. Let him rescue him, since he delights in him.”

paite: Nang sul a kipan a hon lakhepa na hi a, ka nu ang a nawi ka tep lai nangawn in nang muandan na hon sinsaksakta hi.
english: But you brought me out of the womb. You made me trust while at my mother’s breasts.

paite: Sul a kipan him in nangmah tung ah ngak ka na hi a, ka nu gilsung ah ka Pathian na hi hi.
english: I was thrown on you from my mother’s womb. You are my God since my mother bore me.

paite: Hon gamlat mahmah ke'n; mangbatna ding anai ngal a; panpihtu ding a-om tuan kei hi.
english: Don’t be far from me, for trouble is near. For there is no one to help.

paite: Bawngtal tampi in ahon umsuak ua, Bashan gam a bawngtal hattakte’n hon umsuak uhi;
english: Many bulls have surrounded me. Strong bulls of Bashan have encircled me.

paite: Humpinelkai duhgawl humham bang in ahon kamkatkhum uhi.
english: They open their mouths wide against me, lions tearing prey and roaring.

paite: Tui bang in buakkhiak in ka om a, ka guh tengteng leng akilawi hi; ka lungtang khuainun bang ahi a, ka gil lak ah azul khinta hi;
english: I am poured out like water. All my bones are out of joint. My heart is like wax. It is melted within me.

paite: Ka tha belpei bang in akeu khin a; ka lei ka dangtawng ah abelh bikbek a; nang sihna leivui ah na hon pilutta hi.
english: My strength is dried up like a potsherd. My tongue sticks to the roof of my mouth. You have brought me into the dust of death.

paite: Uite'n ahon umsuak uа; thil hoih lou hih omkhawmte'n hon umbit ua; ka khut leh ka khete avut uhi.
english: For dogs have surrounded me. A company of evildoers have enclosed me. They have pierced my hands and feet.

paite: Ka guh tengteng ka sim thei a; amau lah hon en in hon ensal ua;
english: I can count all of my bones. They look and stare at me.

paite: Ka puansilhte akihawm ua, ka puanak ding in ai asan uhi.
english: They divide my garments among them. They cast lots for my clothing.

paite: Nang bel, TOUPA aw, hon gamlat mahmah ke'n! Hon hihhatpa aw, hon panpih ding in hong kin in!
english: But don’t be far off, Yahweh. You are my help. Hurry to help me!

paite: Ka hinna namsau lak ah humbit inla; ka neihsun pentak ui thilhihtheihna lak ah humbit in!
english: Deliver my soul from the sword, my precious life from the power of the dog.

paite: Humpinelkai kam a kipan in hon hondam inla; ahi, gam bawngtal kii a kipan in ka kha hondam in!
english: Save me from the lion’s mouth! Yes, you have rescued me from the horns of the wild oxen.

paite: Ka unaute kiang ah na min ka hilh ding a; kikhawmte lak ah ka hon phat ding hi;
english: I will declare your name to my brothers. Among the assembly, I will praise you.

paite: TOUPA laudan siamte aw, amah phat un; Jakob suan tengteng aw, amah pahtawi un; Israel suante aw, amah kihta un!
english: You who fear Yahweh, praise him! All you descendants of Jacob, glorify him! Stand in awe of him, all you descendants of Israel!

paite: Ama'n gimthuakmi gimdan amusit ngal kei a, akih sam kei; amai lah alak ah asel kei; amah asap in angaikhe zaw hi.
english: For he has not despised nor abhorred the affliction of the afflicted, neither has he hidden his face from him; but when he cried to him, he heard.

paite: Kikhopna thupitak a ka hon phat zel zaw nangmah na hi; alaudan siamte ma ah ka thuchiam ka tangtun ding hi.
english: My praise of you comes in the great assembly. I will pay my vows before those who fear him.

paite: Thunuailutte'n ane ding ua, atai ding uh, amah zongte'n TOUPA aphat ding uh; na lungtang uh tangtawn in hing in om hen!
english: The humble shall eat and be satisfied. They shall praise Yahweh who seek after him. Let your hearts live forever.

paite: Kawlmong a mi tengteng in leng athei nawn ding ua, TOUPA lam angata ding uh; nam chih a chi chih na ma ah akun ding uhi.
english: All the ends of the earth shall remember and turn to Yahweh. All the relatives of the nations shall worship before you.

paite: Gam TOUPA a ahi a, namte tung a vaihawmpa ahi.
english: For the kingdom is Yahweh’s. He is the ruler over the nations.

paite: Lei a mi nei zou tengtengte'n ane un abe ding ua; leivui dia paisuak dingte ama ah ahong kun ding uhi; amau hinna hingsak gige theiloute.
english: All the rich ones of the earth shall eat and worship. All those who go down to the dust shall bow before him, even he who can’t keep his soul alive.

paite: Chisuan in amah nek-le-tak abawl ding a; khangthak hong om nawnte kiang ah TOUPA tanchin ahilh ding uhi.
english: Posterity shall serve him. Future generations shall be told about the Lord.

paite: Ahong pai ding ua, nam hong pawt ding kiang ah, ahih khinta, chi in adiktatdan ahon theisak ding uhi.
english: They shall come and shall declare his righteousness to a people that shall be born, for he has done it.
